'''2007 Worlds Team Justin Desai DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Sol Card ISB Huntdown. Treachery/Drag (V) OCR may redlink.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Desai]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out From The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
